body:
This sort of syntax where you refer to a parameter name as a variable is subpar. (This occurs several times in your changes.)

Probably the simplest option is "and with the following steps given _result_:". You could also use [optional named parameters](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#algorithm-params), but that seems like overkill for now. Although, it might be important once we move "perform the fetch" steps to become an optional named parameter, so I could go either way...

I kept it as a normal parameter, because in many places we just pass it as-is to another algorithms:

> To do XXX given onComplete, run the following steps.
> 1. Do YYY with ..., and onComplete.

vs

> To do XXX given onComplete, run the following steps.
> 1. Do YYY with ..., and if onComplete was given pass it along.
